paragraphs.en: God's Eye View brings public signals into one explorable globe. Track the world live. Talk to it. Break it. Extend it.
paragraphs.zh: 「上帝之眼」（God's Eye View）将公开信号汇集到一个可探索的地球仪中。实时追踪世界动态。与它对话。拆解它。扩展它。

paragraphs.en: Flight transponders, ship beacons, orbital elements, seismographs, and public cameras already tell us a lot about the world. God's Eye View puts them in the same place, so you can move between a global picture and an individual aircraft, ship, or street. It runs locally in your browser, with source code you can inspect and extend.
paragraphs.zh: 飞行应答机、船舶信标、轨道参数、地震仪和公共摄像头已经让我们对世界有了很多了解。 上帝之眼视图将它们汇聚在同一处，让你可以在全球概览与单个飞机、船舶或街道之间自由切换。 它在浏览器中本地运行，附带可供查看和扩展的源代码。

paragraphs.en: Using an older launcher or opening the embedded view manually? If the globe is very choppy, before treating that as a GPU compatibility or minimum-hardware problem, copy the local server URL shown by Pinokio and open the same URL in your normal hardware-accelerated browser. One Pinokio 8.2.0 user reported severe stutter in Pinokio's embedded view that went away when the same running server was opened in an external browser ( #365 ). That points to the embedded browser rather than the app server or your hardware; it does not establish a minimum GPU requirement.

paragraphs.en: When you widen the publish, also set GEV_KEY_SETUP_TRUSTED_PEERS=none so the launcher trusts no gateway address.
paragraphs.zh: 当您扩大发布范围时，还应设置 GEV_KEY_SETUP_TRUSTED_PEERS=none，以使启动器不信任任何网关地址。

paragraphs.en: GEV_KEY_SETUP_TRUSTED_PEERS=none docker compose up Compose forwards GEV_KEY_SETUP_TRUSTED_PEERS and GEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS from your shell or the project's .env ; an exported shell value takes precedence. You can also put GEV_KEY_SETUP_TRUSTED_PEERS=none in .env for a persistent setting. Unset or blank trusted peers retain automatic gateway discovery; none explicitly disables it. The startup log confirms that no additional peers are trusted.

paragraphs.en: Run it as the user who should own the files it writes. id shows the numbers; for yourself on Linux:
paragraphs.zh: 以应该拥有其写入文件的用户身份运行它。id 显示这些数字；对于你自己在 Linux 上：

paragraphs.en: env UID= $( id -u ) GID= $( id -g ) docker compose up On a NAS, clone onto the share you want the data on and use the share owner's ids:
paragraphs.zh: env UID= $( id -u ) GID= $( id -g ) docker compose up 在 NAS（网络附加存储）上，将代码克隆到你想存放数据的共享目录中，并使用该共享目录所有者的用户 ID 和组 ID：

paragraphs.en: cd /volume1/docker git clone https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view.git cd gods-eye-view env UID=1026 GID=100 docker compose up -d Keep the env : bash treats UID as read-only, so a plain UID=1026 in front of a command is silently ignored. If the container can't write the checkout, it says so at start. Docker Desktop on macOS and Windows maps ownership for you.
paragraphs.zh: cd /volume1/docker git clone https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view.git cd gods-eye-view env UID=1026 GID=100 docker compose up -d 请保留 env：bash 将 UID 视为只读，因此直接在命令前写 UID=1026 会被静默忽略。 如果容器无法写入检出目录，它会在启动时说明这一点。 macOS 和 Windows 上的 Docker Desktop 会为你自动映射所有权。

paragraphs.en: On SELinux hosts (Fedora, RHEL), compose mounts the checkout with :z so the container may read it; Docker may relabel the checkout for container access, which can take a moment on a large checkout. Without that, the start fails with Cannot find module '/app/scripts/docker-start.mjs' .
paragraphs.zh: 在 SELinux 主机（Fedora、RHEL）上，compose 会以 ：z 方式挂载检出目录，以便容器可以读取它；Docker 可能会为容器访问重新标记检出目录，在较大的检出上这可能需要一些时间。 如果没有这一步，启动将失败并报错 Cannot find module '/app/scripts/docker-start.mjs'。

paragraphs.en: Keys are upgrades, not prerequisites. When you want one, click the POWER UP chip in the bottom-right corner: Provider Settings lists every supported key, what it switches on, and where to get it. Once everything is configured the chip reads POWERED UP — and if a compact layout hides it, ?setup=1 reopens the same panel.

paragraphs.en: GEV reads Codex's file credentials but does not write or refresh them. It checks token shape and expiry, and reports expired sign-in as requiring re-authentication. The login button runs codex login , permits one pending attempt, and reports exit failures or a two-minute timeout. CODEX_HOME must match the directory that Codex uses. If CODEX_AUTH_JSON points elsewhere, sign in separately or fix that mismatch before using the button. Codex credential storage must use auth.json ; Keychain-only and in-memory storage are not readable by GEV. On Windows, the login button may not be able to start an npm-installed Codex; run codex login yourself, then select OAuth. See Codex credential storage .
paragraphs.zh: GEV 会读取 Codex 的文件凭据，但不会写入或刷新它们。 它会检查令牌的格式和有效期，并将已过期的登录状态报告为需要重新认证。 登录按钮会运行 codex login ，只允许一个待处理的尝试，并报告退出失败或两分钟超时。 CODEX_HOME 必须与 Codex 所使用的目录一致。 如果 CODEX_AUTH_JSON 指向其他位置，请单独登录或在使用登录按钮之前修正这一不一致。 Codex 凭据存储必须使用 auth.json ；仅使用钥匙串和内存存储的凭据无法被 GEV 读取。 在 Windows 上，登录按钮可能无法启动通过 npm 安装的 Codex；请自行运行 codex login ，然后选择 OAuth。 请参阅 Codex 凭据存储 。

paragraphs.en: Setup. At mapillary.com/dashboard/developers , register an application with Read access and copy its Client Token ( MLY|… ). Paste it into POWER UP → Mapillary , or set MAPILLARY_CLIENT_TOKEN in .env and restart. Without it the panel reads KEY REQUIRED . Google Street View uses GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY with the Maps JavaScript API enabled for it in Google Cloud; its chip starts off, since every panorama is billed to the key. KartaView and Panoramax need nothing: their public APIs are keyless.

paragraphs.en: Use. Turn on Street Level under DATA LAYERS → Cameras, or with the pill in the STREET LEVEL panel header. Each provider has a chip in its own colour (Mapillary green), and one is lit at a time: lighting one switches the others off. Mapillary, which is free, is lit by default. Zoom in to street level (below 60 km) for the coverage lines; from orbit the panel says to zoom in. The IMAGERY (ALL / 360° / FLAT) and SINCE filters apply to Mapillary, KartaView and Panoramax; Street View panoramas are all 360°, so with Street View lit the filters are hidden. Click a coverage line for its image cones and a cone to open the photo. Light KARTAVIEW (purple) and zoom in below about 6 km: its lines are the streets KartaView has photos of, and a click on one opens the photo nearest the click, flat or 360° (drag to look around), with cones along its drive; ‹ › or ← → step through the drive (Shift+← →, ↑ ↓ and + − look around a 360° photo; pinch zooms on a phone). paragraphs.en: The server allows two concurrent sessions. Each retains at most 12 segments and 24 MiB in memory; individual downloads are capped at 4 MiB with a ten second deadline. There are no segment files or ffmpeg processes. Redirects, off-origin references, encrypted playlists and non-MPEG-TS segments are refused. Each decoder has its own client lease (at most eight per session), including native HLS. Closing it releases only that lease; abandoned leases expire after 15 seconds without access. The last release stops upstream work. Failed live video uses the existing still/Street View/synthetic fallback, which is not live video. RTMP-only sources are not supported by this integration.
paragraphs.zh: 服务器允许两个并发会话。 每个会话在内存中最多保留 12 个分段和 24 MiB；单个下载的上限为 4 MiB，超时时间为十秒。 没有分段文件，也没有 ffmpeg 进程。 重定向、跨源引用、加密播放列表以及非 MPEG-TS 分段都会被拒绝。 每个解码器拥有自己的客户端租约（每个会话最多八个），包括原生 HLS。 关闭它只会释放该租约；被遗弃的租约在 15 秒内无访问后过期。 最后一次释放会停止上游工作。 实时视频失败时会使用现有的静态图/街景/合成画面回退方案，这不是实时视频。 仅支持 RTMP 的源不被本集成支持。

paragraphs.en: Everything above is the deliberately cheap baseline — enough to get a real taste of geospatial intelligence, GEOINT, and OSINT without ever talking to a sales team. You'll also notice the ceiling: terrestrial AIS goes quiet mid-ocean and satellite AIS costs real money; premium imagery, SAR, and the deeper commercial feeds live behind enterprise contracts. That's not a limit of the architecture — every layer here is a pattern you can point at your own data sources. This repo hands you the foundation; what you fuse into it is up to you.

paragraphs.en: By default nobody else can reach your server — it binds to localhost. To share on your LAN, opt in explicitly ( npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4173 , or HOST=0.0.0.0 ./scripts/dev-fresh.sh on macOS/Linux). IP addresses work as they are; if you use a LAN hostname, add it with GEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS=globe.lan , since binding to 0.0.0.0 does not trust arbitrary Host headers. But know that ⚠️ a LAN-visible server brokers your configured API keys to anyone who can reach it. Per-IP throttles on the cost-bearing endpoints are on by default ( GEV_RATELIMIT_OPENAI_PER_MIN , GEV_RATELIMIT_GOOGLE_PER_MIN — see .env.example to tune them), but before anything else, configure provider quotas, usage limits, and billing alerts : app-level throttles are not billing caps, and a budget alert alone does not stop spending. Full threat model in SECURITY.md .
paragraphs.zh: 默认情况下，其他人无法访问你的服务器——它绑定到 localhost。 若要在局域网中共享，请显式选择启用（npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4173，或在 macOS/Linux 上使用 HOST=0.0.0.0 ./scripts/dev-fresh.sh）。 IP 地址可以直接使用；如果你使用局域网主机名，请通过 GEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS=globe.lan 将其添加，因为绑定到 0.0.0.0 并不会信任任意的 Host 头。 但请注意 ⚠️：局域网内可见的服务器会将你配置的 API 密钥提供给任何能访问它的人。 涉及费用消耗的端点默认启用了按 IP 的限流（GEV_RATELIMIT_OPENAI_PER_MIN、GEV_RATELIMIT_GOOGLE_PER_MIN——请参见 .env.example 进行调整），但最重要的是，先配置提供商的配额、用量限制和账单提醒：应用层限流并不等同于账单上限，仅有预算提醒也无法阻止消费。 完整的威胁模型请参见 SECURITY.md。

paragraphs.en: God's Eye View runs on public data, clear sources, and local-first execution. No secrets, no private datasets, no mystery scraping — anything involving a private key is brokered server-side. It has the visual grammar of a classified ops room, built entirely from open signals and inspectable code.
paragraphs.zh: God's Eye View（上帝视角）运行于公开数据、清晰来源和本地优先的执行方式之上。 没有机密，没有私有数据集，没有神秘的抓取——任何涉及私钥的操作都由服务端代理处理。 它拥有机密作战室般的视觉语法，却完全由公开信号和可审查的代码构建而成。

paragraphs.en: The line. This project models events, assets, infrastructure, and systems — aircraft, vessels, satellites, fires, cameras, cities. It does not build features for named-person search, face recognition, or tracking individuals, and pull requests that cross that line won't be merged. People are not a query type here.
paragraphs.zh: 这条界线。 本项目对事件、资产、基础设施和系统进行建模——包括飞机、船只、卫星、火灾、摄像头、城市。 本项目不构建针对特定人员搜索、人脸识别或追踪个人的功能，越界的拉取请求不会被合并。 在这里，人不是一种查询类型。

paragraphs.en: God's Eye View is an exploratory visualization of public and third-party data. Data may be delayed, incomplete, modeled, inferred, or wrong. Do not use it for flight or maritime navigation, emergency response, medical or health decisions, investment decisions, or other safety-critical or operational purposes. paragraphs.en: One heads-up from the inside: build in this space for a week and you learn that the present is the cheap part . The moment you try to go back in time — tiling, serving, and scrubbing what happened and what changed at any real resolution — the data gets expensive and the compute gets brutal. That's the long game.
paragraphs.zh: 来自内部人士的一个提醒：在这个领域构建一周后你就会明白，当下是成本最低的部分。 一旦你想回到过去——以任何真实的分辨率去平铺、服务和回溯当时发生了什么、发生了什么变化——数据就变得昂贵，计算也变得残酷。那才是长期的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Update — a hosted version is coming. We originally planned to keep this repository as the open-source client and build a separate professional product. Then the launch happened, and the loudest request wasn't another feature — it was "just give me a link." So we're building an official hosted God's Eye View at Halfpixel : no installation, just open it in your browser. The hosted version is the easiest way into this open-source project. More soon.
paragraphs.zh: 更新——托管版本即将推出。 我们原本计划把这个仓库保留为开源客户端，另外开发一款独立的专业产品。 然后产品发布了，呼声最高的请求不是某个新功能——而是“直接给我一个链接就行”。所以我们正在 Halfpixel 构建官方托管的 God's Eye View：无需安装，在浏览器里打开即可。 托管版本是体验这个开源项目最简单的方式。更多内容敬请期待。
